A fix-and-polish release: a new main menu, Settings, a first preview of the map editor, and a fix for text turning into black blocks. Still early: placeholder art, no sound yet.

## Download and play

- **Windows:** download `arcane-dome-v0.1.2-windows-x86_64.zip`, unzip it, run `arcane-dome.exe`.
- **Linux:** download `arcane-dome-v0.1.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`, unpack it, run `./arcane-dome`. Needs the usual desktop libraries (ALSA, X11, Xi, OpenGL), which most desktops already have.

Keep the `assets` folder next to the game.

## What's new

- **Fixed:** all text could turn into black blocks (and use a lot of memory) when text at a new size appeared, for example right after resizing the window. Please update if you play v0.1.1.
- **New main menu:** Quick Match (the old Match Setup), Map Editor, Settings, View Changes, and a first look at what is coming (greyed out for now).
- **Settings:** fullscreen, menu slides, blood effects and an FPS counter, remembered between runs. **F11** switches fullscreen any time.
- **Nameplates:** the bar over each fighter is their health in their team colour, with their name on it. Yours has a bright frame.
- Menu pages slide into each other.

## Map editor (preview)

Draw terrain shapes, place spawns, pickups and gadgets, undo and redo, save drafts, open any map or start a new one. Every button explains itself when you rest the mouse on it, and **Instructions (F1)** covers the rest.

Drafts are saved in `assets/editor/`. **Playing your own maps is not possible yet**: checking, test-playing and publishing maps into Quick Match come in the next update.

Full history: `CHANGELOG.md`, or View Changes in the game.
